name: network-cross-account-connectivity
description: Add the new workload account into the existing shared TR scope and attach its workload VPC to the shared transit router.

network_account_id.description: Output from 05-network: the network account ID that owns the shared TR.

transit_router_id.description: Output from 05-network: the shared transit router ID.

transit_router_resource_share_name.description: Output from 05-network: the reusable TR resource share name owned by the network account.

transit_router_dmz_public_route_table_na.description: Output from 05-network: the shared TR route table name used for DMZ/public egress learning.

transit_router_egress_route_table_name.description: Output from 05-network: the shared TR route table name used for workload-account default egress association.

network_vpc_attachment_id.description: Output from 05-network: the shared network-foundation VPC attachment ID used as the egress next hop.

workload_vpc_cidr.description: CIDR block for the new workload-account VPC.

workload_subnet_cidr_az_a.description: CIDR block for workload subnet in availability zone A.

workload_subnet_cidr_az_b.description: CIDR block for workload subnet in availability zone B.

availability_zone_a.description: Availability zone A in the target region, for example cn-beijing-a.

availability_zone_b.description: Availability zone B in the target region, for example cn-beijing-b.

baselines.name: network-cross-account-connectivity
baselines.description: Update the existing TR share for the current account and create the workload-side attachment.
